title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Mapping the DeFi Stack

questions.text: Which layer of the DeFi stack provides the stable settlement currency for transactions?
questions.explanation: Stablecoins are designed to maintain a stable value, serving as the settlement layer.

questions.text: True or false: Aggregators automatically find the best swap rates across multiple DEXs and lending protocols.
questions.explanation: Aggregators scan multiple protocols to route trades at optimal rates.
